title: Ed Miliband announces first sanctions on Israeli firms working in West Bank
summary_full: Move is designed to hinder building of more illegal settlements, which Foreign Office says Israel has ‘refused to clamp down on’UK politics live – latest updatesEd Miliband has announced the first set of sanctions against Israeli companies planning to build illegal settlements in the West Bank, after he pledged to try to prevent settlements that destroy the chances of a two-state solution.The UK foreign secretary also announced he was placing sanctions on a rightwing activist Israeli group involved in trying to block aid into Gaza as recently as last month.
